## Before Opening

External code contributions are currently by invitation.

If an Olyx maintainer explicitly asked for this pull request, keep it narrowly
scoped and complete the checklist below. Otherwise, please close the PR and use
the issue templates instead.

## Checklist

- [ ] Command help and README examples stay in sync
- [ ] No API keys, local databases, or customer payloads are included
- [ ] Tests were added or updated where behavior changed
- [ ] Dependencies pass the public package boundary check
